model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Viggle Image Swap 7B
model.description: Replaces people in a picture with characters from character sheets, keeping their pose, expression, framing, background and lighting. Add the picture first, then one sheet per person: it runs in 6 steps at about 1 MP with Viggle's Image Swap LoRA built in. The adapter is licensed for non-commercial research and evaluation.

prompt: Replace the man in a green shirt in image 1 with the character from image 2. Keep everything else exactly as in image 1: the pose, expression, framing, background and lighting.
